$description: What is enforced vs convention. Category keys equal token-catalog.json keys (checked by verify_all.py).

rawValueRestrictions.color: Never emit a raw hex/rgb value; reference a color token.
rawValueRestrictions.fontFamily: Only the registered families; commercial fonts are reference-only (see assets/asset-roles.json font-file).

convention: token usage inside rendered markup (no PageSpec field carries styling)

overrides: PageSpecs carry no per-instance style or token-override field: styling is owned by section/component contracts. There is therefore no PageSpec-level token validation to run; drift is caught at the catalog/policy layer by verify_all.py.
